title: Year 3 end-of-year SPaG check
subject: English
source: Written for english/y3 lesson 103 (Year 3 end-of-year SPaG check: 20 grammar and punctuation questions and 15 spellings (teacher-written, in the portal and printable))
intro: Lesson 103. Sections A to C: grammar and punctuation (20 questions). Section D: 15 spellings read by the teacher.

blocks.h: Sections A to C: grammar and punctuation

questions.q: Add inverted commas: Look out! shouted the captain.
Write in the present perfect: I (find) a rock.
Add a comma after the fronted adverbial: After the eruption the island grew.
questions.a: After the eruption, the island grew.

questions.q: Choose a or an: ___ island
Underline the conjunction: The sea hissed when the lava arrived.
Underline the preposition: The birds nested on the cliffs.
Turn into a question: The island is shrinking.
Add an apostrophe: the islands name
Write the plural: volcano
Underline the adverb: The lava flowed slowly.
Add a prefix to make the opposite: appear
Add a suffix: hope + ful
Choose: The (whole / hole) island shook.
Write the past tense: The boat sails north.
Join with 'because': The ground was rich. Birds lived there.
questions.a: The ground was rich because birds lived there.

questions.q: Which word is a noun? The scientists visited quickly.
Correct the capital letters: in november we visited iceland.
Add the missing punctuation: What a huge cloud
Choose the pronoun: Amna and ___ (I / me) planted seeds.
Write a sentence with 'although'.
questions.a: For example: Although it was cold, we went outside.

blocks.answers: 1 accident; 2 actually; 3 believe; 4 build; 5 busy; 6 calendar; 7 caught; 8 centre; 9 decide; 10 describe; 11 different; 12 difficult; 13 disappear; 14 early; 15 earth
